A1:C4 native order Beta, Alpha, Gamma becomes visible Alpha, Beta, Gamma when sorted; exiting restores native order.
Editing visible A2 from Alpha to Alpha edited changes original stored row3, confirmed by exiting and copying A1:D4.

Formula =A2 entered at D2 outside view range displays Alpha while view active and Beta after exit. Formula references therefore require view-aware presentation, beyond merely reordering rendered values.

Additional disposable-fixture probe: C2:C4 contain =ROW()*100+LEN(A2), =ROW()*100+LEN(A3), =ROW()*100+LEN(A4). In the A1:C4 sorted view, visible C2 shows 312 and its formula bar shows =ROW()*100+LEN(A2), while original C3 is the source row. Values follow underlying evaluation rather than evaluating the displayed formula at its visible row.

A cross-row relative formula stored at B3 as =A2&"/"&$A$3&"/"&ROW($A$2) is displayed at view B2 as =A1&"/"&$A$3&"/"&ROW($A$2), with #REF! and an error explaining that references in a sorted view must refer to the same row or have an absolute row number. Exiting the view removes this view-only error.
Entering =$A$3&"/"&ROW($A$3) at view B2 displays Alpha edited/3 while visible A3 is Beta: absolute rows retain underlying-sheet references.

Entering =LEN(A2)+ROW()*1000 at visible C2 stores =LEN(A3)+ROW()*1000 in underlying C3. After exiting the view and reloading, C3 retains the translated formula and value3012; native row order and D2=Beta remain intact.

Sorted-view A2:C4 copying emits visible Alpha edited/Beta/Gamma order and formatted values. Pasting that internal selection at E2 preserves displayed order but shifts formulas by visible positions: view C2 formula =LEN(A2)+ROW()*1000 becomes G2 =LEN(E2)+ROW()*1000, value2012.

An absolute formula pasted outside the sorted-view range at F2 evaluates $A$3 against the visible view (Beta/3 while active), then returns Alpha edited/3 after leaving the view. This differs from the original in-view cell, whose displayed value follows its underlying-row evaluation.

Cutting sorted A2:C4 and pasting at E7:G9 is allowed. Readback after exiting shows A2:C4 empty and the destination in visible Alpha edited/Beta/Gamma order, with relocated formulas and changed dependent references. One undo after exiting reentered the view. Exact cut-reference rewrite rules still require additional conformance before implementation.
